_doc: Motor calibration tool config (mpc::load_motor_calib_config / mpc::MotorCalibConfig). Absent keys keep the compiled defaults shown here. robot_ip and motive_body_name/robot_topic_name are DELIBERATE placeholders -- fill in the real robot's IP and its actual Motive rigid-body/planner names before running a real session. line.line_yaw_rad=null means 'use the robot's initial heading at capture time as the line axis' (see mpc::LineFrame); set a number to override. safety.* are shared with mpc_controller's own hardware-safety conventions in spirit but are calibration-session-only limits (see mpc::TrialRunnerConfig). sweeps.duty/sweeps.erpm are the raw command values to sweep in each mode (a later agent's motor_calibration binary decides how to alternate direction/interleave modes across these). trial.steady_window_frac feeds mpc::steady_state_v(); trial.settle_s/arm_settle_s/max_duration_s feed mpc::TrialRunnerConfig (see mpc::make_trial_runner_config). output_dir is relative to the process's working directory.
